parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe the basic differences in content between the Old Testament and New Testament.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain the importance of the New Testament for Christians.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘The Old Testament is still a useful guide for Christians today.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Christianity in your answer.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Give an account of one story from the life of Jesus in which he suffered.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain Christian beliefs about God forgiving sins.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘It is not easy to “be perfect” as Jesus commanded.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Christianity in your answer.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe one Christian ceremony in which the Holy Spirit is believed to be present.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain what Christians believe about the work of the Holy Spirit.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘Prayers are always answered.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Christianity in your answer. 
Section B – Islam
If you have chosen this section answer all of the parts in two of the questions.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe the first revelation of the Qur’an to Muhammad (pbuh).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Explain why God provided for and protected Muhammad (pbuh) during his early life in
Makkah.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘The people of Makkah did not understand the message of Muhammad (pbuh).’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Islam in your answer.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe the customs followed by Muslims after the birth of a baby.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain the benefits to Muslims of using the Qur’an as a guide for life.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘The daily life of Muslims is all about following their religion.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Islam in your answer.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe the traditional Muslim teachings about the care of children and the elderly.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain the challenges faced by Muslims today in trying to follow these teachings.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘Living in the modern world is all about accepting change.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Islam in your answer. 
Section C – Judaism
If you have chosen this section answer all of the parts in two of the questions.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe two of the sections of the Tenakh.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain why obeying the mitzvot is central to Jewish life.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘Judaism is more than just a set of laws that have to be obeyed.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Judaism in your answer.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe a Brit Milah (circumcision) ceremony.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain why Brit Milah is an important event for the whole Jewish community.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘A caring family life is the main strength of Judaism.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Judaism in your answer.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe the traditional teachings on the roles and responsibilities of men in Judaism.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain why some Jews have accepted changes to the traditional roles of women in Judaism.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘Wearing traditional clothing for prayer makes it more special.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Judaism in your answer.
